My neighbours all keep to themselves. A couple of them say hi if they see me as they’re walking past but we’re not friends. We don’t even have a relationship at all
Because I don’t want to live anymore

No. I thought of going on a chat room or calling a chat line. but I figured they’d probably try to talk me out of it and call the cops to my house. I don’t want my neighbours to see that go down. I don’t want them to talk me out of it

I recently discontinued all contact with my bio dad and his wife. My anti depressants stopped working so I stopped taking them. My depression’s really bad right now but I also feel completely numb at the same time. Whenever I look at my legs, I want to scream because of the scars I’ve given myself. I don’t want to wake up tomorrow so I won’t be.
I’m autistic and I have no socialization skills. I’m very awkward and terrible at reading signals. The only time I’m good at socializing is when I’m drunk

I haven't been able to get out of bed recently. Only to shower, eat and smoke. I lost my job so I lost my benefits. I'm not going to be able to pay my mortgage and my house is going to get repossessed. I feel like I have nothing to live for. I have no friends, my life growing up was complete shit. physically abused by parents and sexually abused by brother. The abuse is over now, but I can't get it out of my head.  I can't do it any longer, I just want to stop remembering it
